_meta.indication: Treatment of mild-to-moderate COVID-19 in adults who are at high risk for progression to severe COVID-19, including hospitalization or death.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2/3 global trial; randomized 1:1 to 5 days of PAXLOVID versus placebo.
pivotal_trials.population: Non-hospitalized adults with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 who were unvaccinated against COVID-19 and at high risk for progression to severe disease.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects with COVID-19 related hospitalization or death from any cause through Day 28 (primary, mITT population).
pivotal_trials.result: Primary endpoint (mITT): event in 5/671 (0.7%) PAXLOVID vs 44/647 (6.8%) placebo; estimated difference in proportion -6.1% (95% CI: -8.2, -4.1; nominal p<0.0001). First key secondary endpoint (mITT1): event in 9/977 (0.9%) PAXLOVID vs 64/989 (6.5%) placebo; 5.6% absolute reduction (95% CI: -7.3% to -4.0%; p<0.0001), 86% relative reduction (95% CI: 72%, 93%).

key_safety: Favorable safety profile; most common adverse reactions were dysgeusia and diarrhea (in EPIC-HR PAXLOVID group 4.6% and 3.0% versus 0.1% and 1.5% placebo). Key safety concern is serious adverse reactions from drug-drug interactions.
target_moa: Nirmatrelvir is a first-in-class peptidomimetic inhibitor of the SARS-CoV-2 main protease (Mpro); ritonavir is a CYP3A inhibitor that boosts nirmatrelvir exposure.
modality: Small molecule (peptidomimetic protease inhibitor co-packaged with ritonavir).

boxed_warning.content: Risk of serious adverse reactions due to drug interactions: PAXLOVID includes ritonavir, a strong CYP3A inhibitor, which may lead to greater exposure of certain concomitant medications, resulting in potentially severe, life-threatening, or fatal events.

advisory_committee.vote: Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee met March 16, 2023; a majority (94%) of committee members agreed the overall benefit-risk assessment is favorable for PAXLOVID.

description.text: Added dosing recommendations for patients with severe renal impairment including those requiring hemodialysis

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application updates the U.S. Prescribing Information and Patient Information to include dosing recommendations in patients with severe renal impairment including those requiring hemodialysis based on data from Study C4671028.
